name: CodeSystemImagingRegionMyCore
title: CodeSystemImagingRegion (MY Core)
description: LEGACY. The 110-concept national imaging region list exported from the RIS menu tree. RETIRED as a binding target in 2.1.0: body site now binds to RadLex anatomy (radlex-anatomy-my-core, 38,178 concepts). Analysis for v2.1 found that only 63 of the 110 concepts were body regions at all; the rest were procedures, modalities or administrative categories. Every concept is tagged with a conceptClass property, and the body regions carry a RadLex mapping, so legacy extracts can be translated through ConceptMap/imaging-region-my-core-to-radlex.

property.description: What this concept actually is: region, procedure, modality-technique or administrative. Only 'region' is bindable on bodySite.
Equivalent RadLex concept (RID), where one exists. RadLex is published by RSNA and is free to use with attribution.
